messages:
ashwin: Heads up — after the SCIM attribute migration last night I found several service accounts that were unintentionally granted the org-admin role. :warning:
laura: Which migration are you referring to? the extId -> employeeID change? :eyes:
ashwin: Yes, that one. The mapping change deployed at 2026-03-19T02:13:24Z. Quick grep from the scim audit shows a few entries where a service account got added to org-admin. Snippet:
```
provisioner-bot: provision job 2026-03-19T02:13:24Z apply
  target: scim-mapping-v2
  diff: memberOf mapping changed -> group resolution used `department` fallback
result: added role org-admin to svc-account-42
```
devin: Can you paste the SCIM patch payload that triggered it? I want to see the attribute names / types.
ashwin: Payload we pushed (sanitized):
```
PATCH /scim/v2/ServiceProviderConfig
{
  "mappings": {
    "memberOf": "attributes.groups || attributes.department",
    "isServiceAccount": "attributes.svc_account"
  }
}
```
laura: Hmm, looks like the old pipeline expected `isServiceAccount` boolean but the new mapping points at `svc_account` and for a bunch of imported SAs that attr is missing -> evaluated as falsy -> no exclusion from role assignment.
ashwin: Exactly. The result was group resolution adding `org-admin` when `department` matched a legacy admin group. 6 service accounts affected so far.
devin: Quick queries to enumerate affected accounts: run these against the audit DB /prod-audit (read-only):
```
-- list service-like usernames added to org-admin during window
SELECT username, event_ts FROM scim_audit
WHERE event_ts BETWEEN 1895006400 AND 1895007600
  AND change_type = 'membership.add'
  AND group = 'org-admin'
  AND username LIKE 'svc-%';
```
provisioner-bot: scheduled group-sync run completed 2026-03-19T02:14:01Z; changes: 67 adds, 2 removes; run_id=gs-20260319-0214
laura: I'm going to run the revoke playbook for those 6 accounts and then roll back the mapping to the previous version. Will also open a short timeline for the audit log.
ashwin: Thanks. For immediate mitigation: rollback mapping, run a dry-run group-sync, then a forced reconcile that only removes memberships we added in that window.
devin: After revoke, we should add a policy gate to the provisioner: never grant admin roles to accounts where `isServiceAccount` is true (or attr missing). Add a fail-if for undefined svc flag.
ops-bot: revoke-playbook started by laura at 2026-03-19T02:45:12Z. Actions: revoke org-admin for 6 accounts; create audit events; notify SRE.
laura: Revoke completed. Audit events created and PR open to rollback mapping: infra/scim/mappings#842. I also kicked off a reconcile job in dry-run first.
ndashwin: (typo) — ashwin: Added follow-up tasks: 1) add unit/integration test in provisioning CI for missing svc attr, 2) add an alert if >3 admin grants occur in a 5m window from group-sync, 3) run a full membership reconciliation for the last 30 days.
devin: I'll own the CI test and the alert. Will open a ticket and link runbooks.
ashwin: Good. Closing the immediate incident but leaving this thread open for postmortem notes. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
